note: Shortlist for the PSMA motion graphics. Every case was picked from the run 5 ensemble per-case CSV (DEMETER, threshold 0.5, 10-voxel filter) by the rule given, before any image was viewed. 'rule_short' is the line shown on screen. Numbers inside rule_short are written as {name} placeholders and listed in rule_numbers, so the stage renders them from manifest entries (gate G8).

cases.label: Case A
cases.rule: Highest per-case F1 among the 32 autoPET-III test scans with at least 20 ground-truth lesions (F1 0.951, 52 lesions). autoPET-III is used for both showcase scans because its labels are expert-drawn, so both share one label convention.
cases.rule_short: Picked from the results table before any image was viewed: the best F1 among autoPET-III test scans with {min_gt} or more lesions.

cases.label: Case B
cases.rule: Lowest defined per-case F1 among the 113 test scans that have one; the 9 lesion-positive scans with no lesion found have no defined F1 and are not eligible (rule 2 of the qualitative-figure rule in documents/temp/2026-10-06-chapter4-plan.md, section 5). Exactly tied at F1 = 2/9 with psma_798b3279d6980a3b_2019-03-04 (1 of 3 lesions found, 5 false alarms); this case comes first in the CSV and has the lower DSC (7.2 against 11.8).
cases.rule_short: Picked from the results table before any image was viewed: the lowest F1 among test scans where at least one lesion was found (tied with one other scan).

cases.label: Alternate A
cases.rule: Highest per-case F1 among the 49 test scans (either cohort) with at least 20 ground-truth lesions (F1 0.968, 49 lesions).
cases.rule_short: Picked from the results table before any image was viewed: the best F1 among all test scans with {min_gt} or more lesions.

cases.label: Alternate B
cases.rule: Under-calling case: the most missed lesions of any test scan (78 of 128), and the lowest F1 among autoPET-III test scans with at least 20 lesions (0.538).
cases.rule_short: Picked from the results table before any image was viewed: the test scan with the most missed lesions.

cases.label: Study C
cases.rule: Figure 4.7 (b) of the dissertation: the DEEP-PSMA sealed test scan at the median per-case F1 (the plain seminar deck's slide 10 scan; tools/seminar-decks/make_plain_scans.py, CASE_C). Added 14 Oct 2026 for the plain deck's 3D second options.
cases.rule_short: The dissertation's qualitative figure: the DEEP-PSMA test scan at its cohort's median F1.
